name: Lotus Embroche
original_name: ロートス・アンブロシ
source:
Shuuma's (deceased) father and the former Progenitor of the Embroche family. [Spoiler]A piece of his soul inhabits a ring Shuuma's mother gave to him before her passing and he occasionally speaks to Shuuma through it to give his commentary on various situations.

He is also a lolicon.
[/Spoiler]
